en.headline: Airport clears Terminal 2 overhead screens after safety checks
en.dek: Five suspended electronic displays at Terminal 2 have been declared safe and the cordoned area reopened; the kinetic movement feature has been permanently disabled.
body: The Airport Authority Hong Kong said five overhead electronic display screens remaining in Terminal 2 meet safety standards after detailed inspections by its maintenance team and independent structural engineers, and the previously cordoned area has been reopened.

One circular screen measuring about 1.5 metres by 1.5 metres malfunctioned on Saturday morning while the system was performing a programmed kinetic sequence. A traction cable problem caused it to drop from roughly 15 metres to about 8 metres before the fall-arrest system engaged. No one was injured. That unit and its cables were removed for further examination.

The authority has installed additional cables on the remaining screens beyond the original dual-cable design that was already intended to prevent a fall. When the displays resume operation they will stay in a fixed position; the automated movement mode has been cancelled to provide extra public reassurance.

Terminal 2’s departure facilities reopened in late May as part of the three-runway system project. The authority said it is treating the incident seriously and continues to investigate the root cause of the cable failure.

zh.headline: 機管局確認T2五塊顯示屏安全 圍封區解封
zh.dek: 機場二號客運大樓懸掛顯示屏經檢查達安全標準，已加裝更多纜索並取消移動模式，相關範圍恢復開放。
body: 機場管理局表示，經維修團隊及獨立結構工程師詳細檢查後，確認目前懸掛於二號客運大樓的五塊電子顯示屏達安全標準，可以重啟展示內容，相關圍封範圍亦已解封。
昨日早上約8時半，一塊約1.5米乘1.5米的圓形顯示屏在移動表演期間因牽引纜索出現問題，由約15米高位置下墜至約8米，防墮系統發揮作用，無人受傷。該顯示屏及纜索已移離大樓作進一步檢查。
機管局已為餘下屏幕加裝更多纜索，原來設計的兩條纜索已可防止墮地，額外纜索進一步加強保障。重啟後所有屏幕將保持固定狀態，取消自動移動模式，以讓公眾安心。
二號客運大樓離境設施於5月底啟用。機管局指正認真調查事件成因，並繼續跟進已移走顯示屏的檢查工作。
